about_zh: 手机与平板上的应用、框架和自动化。

repos.description: Browse media content with your own rules on Android TV
repos.summary_zh: SmartTube 是一款专为 Android TV 设计的免费开源媒体客户端，允许用户通过自定义规则浏览和播放多来源内容。其核心亮点包括 SponsorBlock 集成、可调节播放速度、8K 和 60fps 支持、HDR 兼容性，且无需 Google 服务。应用提供电视优化界面，适合高级用户，但不支持手机和平板，并需注意从官方渠道安装以规避安全风险。
repos.summary_en: SmartTube is a free, open-source media client for Android TVs that enables users to browse and play content with custom rules. Key features include SponsorBlock integration, adjustable playback speed, 8K and 60fps support, HDR compatibility, and no Google Services requirement. It offers a TV-optimized interface for advanced users, but is not compatible with phones or tablets. Users should install from official sources to avoid security risks.

repos.description: 收集全网 Android TV电视盒子应用，涵盖影视、直播、K歌、工具、游戏等类型，整理优质APK资源，支持便捷下载与自动更新。提供安全验证、分类索引与兼容性标注，助力用户打造家庭影音娱乐中心！              ✅ TVBox/影视仓等影音壳接口配置源。
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库收集全网 Android TV 电视盒子应用，涵盖影视、直播、K歌、工具、游戏等类型，整理优质 APK 资源，支持便捷下载与自动更新。提供安全验证、分类索引与兼容性标注，助力用户打造家庭影音娱乐中心。同时提供 TVBox/影视仓等影音壳接口配置源，方便快速搭建个性化影音系统。
repos.summary_en: This repository collects a wide range of Android TV box apps, covering movies, live TV, karaoke, tools, and games. It provides high-quality APK resources with convenient download and auto-update features, along with security verification, category indexing, and compatibility notes. It also offers interface configuration sources for TVBox and similar apps, helping users build a home entertainment center.

repos.description: 一个基于 React native 开发的音乐软件
repos.summary_zh: LX Music移动版是基于React Native与Redux的开源音乐播放器，支持Android，允许自定义音频源并具备数据同步功能。采用Apache 2.0协议，适合追求个性化的音乐爱好者。
repos.summary_en: LX Music Mobile is an open-source music player application developed with React Native and Redux, offering a highly customizable experience for Android users. The app supports custom audio sources, enabling users to pull streaming links from various providers, and includes an optional data synchronization service for multi-device compatibility. Licensed under Apache 2.0, it is designed for music enthusiasts who prioritize flexibility and personalization over out-of-the-box simplicity. The project maintains active development on the dev branch, with regular releases and community contributions welcome.

repos.summary_zh: Nagram是一款基于NekoX的第三方Android Telegram客户端，内置多协议代理与丰富增强功能。它支持多账号无限登录、自定义文本样式、消息合并及语音降噪，致力于提供安全、个性化且功能全面的即时通讯体验。
repos.summary_en: Nagram is a third-party Android Telegram client built on NekoX, featuring robust built-in proxy support (VMess, SSR, Trojan, etc.) and extensive customization. It offers unlimited accounts, message combining, forced copy, voice enhancement, and advanced privacy controls, delivering a highly secure and feature-rich messaging experience.

repos.description: 以 MoonTV v100 版本 / Helios 为后端的 Android TV 客户端，针对遥控器设备优化
repos.summary_zh: Selene-TV 是针对遥控器优化的 Android TV 客户端，基于 Compose for TV 构建。集成 MoonTV 后端，支持双内核播放、多源测速、多平台弹幕及手机扫码遥控，提供沉浸式大屏追剧体验。
repos.summary_en: Selene-TV is an Android TV client designed specifically for D-pad remote controls, integrating seamlessly with the MoonTV and Helios backends. Built using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for TV, it offers dual playback engine support (ExoPlayer/mpv), multi-source aggregation with intelligent speed testing, multi-platform bullet screen merging, and a convenient phone remote control feature. The app provides an immersive, metadata-rich interface with deep navigation optimization and robust caching, delivering a premium, cinema-grade streaming experience for smart TVs and TV boxes.

repos.description: 海因影视，用于lunatv（moontv）的Android TV客户端，以及手机、Windows等多平台客户端，本地缓存比网页版更流畅的访问速度
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Flutter 的跨平台 LunaTV 影视客户端，支持 TV、手机、Windows 及 Linux 多端同步。通过本地缓存与多播放器后端，实现超越网页版的流畅播放，完美适配大屏焦点导航与低版本安卓设备。
repos.summary_en: HeinPlay is a high-performance, cross-platform LunaTV client built with Flutter, supporting Android TV, mobile, Windows, Linux, and HarmonyOS. By leveraging local caching and flexible player backends like fvp and ExoPlayer, it provides smoother streaming than the official web version, optimized for TV focus navigation and legacy Android devices.
